summary: Iteration 2 — full-stack test of Football Intelligence OS: managed-auth (cookie/bearer/logout) and Claude Sonnet 5 SSE copilot endpoint validated via pytest; frontend authenticated flow validated end-to-end via Playwright covering all 22 routes, sidebar groups, command palette (button + ⌘K + Esc), dashboard signals, data-quality honest ERROR badges, copilot streaming through the UI, and 390px mobile responsive with zero horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is instantiated AFTER exchange_session/copilot_query handlers that reference it. Python resolves it lazily at call-time so it works today, but reordering the logger.basicConfig/logger = getLogger to run before route definitions would prevent a future NameError if module-level logging is invoked at import time.
server.py exchange_session still uses requests.get via asyncio.to_thread — functional but a native async client (httpx.AsyncClient) would remove the thread hop for the login-hot path.
Copilot SSE handler does not enforce a max event loop timeout; a long-running Anthropic stream could hold the connection indefinitely — consider an asyncio.wait_for wrapping the generator.

Frontend App.js ProtectedRoute effect has an empty dep array with lint-disabled state setters — fine, but calling axios directly ignores the AbortController pattern; if a user navigates away mid-check the state update will fire after unmount.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 pytest: auth bearer, auth cookie+logout, copilot 401, copilot SSE stream with claude-sonnet-5)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 22 routes render without crash, protected redirect works, session cookie grants /dashboard access with scout@football-os.test, sidebar shows all 8 groups, command palette opens via button and ⌘K and closes on Escape, data-quality shows ERROR (not fabricated healthy), copilot SSE streams >300 chars back from Claude Sonnet 5, mobile 390x844 overflow=0 on /dashboard /players /copilot /market

seed_data_creation: Re-seeded pre-configured test session (user_id=test_ui_football, session_token=test_ui_football_token, email=scout@football-os.test) via the script in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Test-created records TEST_auth_* auto-cleaned by pytest fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/v1/* remains intentionally unmounted; frontend surfaces backend-dependency states — do NOT treat 404s on /api/v1/{players,clubs,matches,features/registry} as bugs. Detail routes /players/:id and /matches/:id render an error-state block (not a page-title element); when asserting them, wait for [data-testid="application-shell"] plus an error-state class rather than page-title. Copilot streaming through UI writes to [data-testid="copilot-message-1"] and the model badge is exactly 'CLAUDE SONNET 5'.
rca of the issue: No functional defects reproduced. Copilot SSE confirmed end-to-end (backend pytest received deltas + done event; UI transcript filled with ~330 characters). Graceful backend-dependency states verified across all Market/Squad/Research/Data-quality pages. Mobile overflow at 390px = 0 for all measured routes.
